_about: EBA Pillar 3 ESG XBRL element binding for Tellumen's bank prudential disclosure export. To finish: set 'namespace' to the official EBA taxonomy namespace and replace each 'element' null with the official EBA DPM element id/local-name. It binds automatically — services/governance/filing_export.py _load_p3_binding() reads this file; a null element stays honestly provisional, a real namespace + real elements flip the export to the official tags. No code change needed.
_taxonomy: EBA Pillar 3 ESG XBRL taxonomy / DPM — PENDING. The EBA will develop the DPM and XBRL taxonomy for the Pillar 3 Data Hub (P3DH). The disclosure ITS was amended in June 2026 (EBA/ITS/2026/02), reference date 31 Dec 2026 (31 Dec 2027 for small & non-complex institutions). Only the machine element ids are pending — the template/column references below are verified against Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/2453 (Annex XXXIX forms + Annex XL instructions).
